//: Lives at the repo root, not in apps/web. With Root Directory set to apps/web, Vercel installs from there and cannot resolve the @ticket/shared workspace — so keep Root Directory as the repo root and point the build at the workspace instead.

rewrites.//: Client-side routing. Without this, opening /verify/<token> from a scanned QR, or /offers/<token> from an email, hits Vercel's static host directly and 404s — and those are precisely the two entry points that arrive as a cold link rather than a click.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints asset filenames, so they can be cached forever. index.html is deliberately excluded and stays revalidated.
A booking QR should not be embeddable in somebody else's page.
